entries.title: I Chronicles 8:1
segments: And Benjamin begat Bela his first-born, Ashbel the second, and Aharah the third,

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:2
segments: Nohah the fourth, and Rapha the fifth.

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:3
segments: And Bela had sons: Addar, and Gera, and Abihud,

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:4
segments: and Abishua, and Naaman, and Ahoah,

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:5
segments: and Gera, and Shephuphan, and Huram.

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:6
segments: And these are the sons of Ehud: these are the heads of fathers' [houses] of the inhabitants of Geba, and they carried them captive to Manahath:

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:7
segments: and Naaman, and Ahijah, and Gera, he carried them captive: and he begat Uzza and Ahihud.

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:8
segments: And Shaharaim begat children in the field of Moab, after he had sent them away; Hushim and Baara were his wives.

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:9
segments: And he begat of Hodesh his wife, Jobab, and Zibia, and Mesha, and Malcam,

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:10
segments: and Jeuz, and Shachia, and Mirmah. These were his sons, heads of fathers' [houses].

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:11
segments: And of Hushim he begat Abitub and Elpaal.

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:12
segments: And the sons of Elpaal: Eber, and Misham, and Shemed, who built Ono and Lod, with the towns thereof;

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:13
segments: and Beriah, and Shema, who were heads of fathers' [houses] of the inhabitants of Aijalon, who put to flight the inhabitants of Gath;

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:14
segments: and Ahio, Shashak, and Jeremoth,

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:15
segments: and Zebadiah, and Arad, and Eder,

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:16
segments: and Michael, and Ishpah, and Joha, the sons of Beriah,

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:17
segments: and Zebadiah, and Meshullam, and Hizki, and Heber,

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:18
segments: and Ishmerai, and Izliah, and Jobab, the sons of Elpaal,

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:19
segments: and Jakim, and Zichri, and Zabdi,

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:20
segments: and Elienai, and Zillethai, and Eliel,

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:21
segments: and Adaiah, and Beraiah, and Shimrath, the sons of Shimei,

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:22
segments: and Ishpan, and Eber, and Eliel,

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:23
segments: and Abdon, and Zichri, and Hanan,

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:24
segments: and Hananiah, and Elam, and Anthothijah,

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:25
segments: and Iphdeiah, and Penuel, the sons of Shashak,

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:26
segments: and Shamsherai, and Shehariah, and Athaliah,

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:27
segments: and Jaareshiah, and Elijah, and Zichri, the sons of Jeroham.

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:28
segments: These were heads of fathers' [houses] throughout their generations, chief men: these dwelt in Jerusalem.

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:29
segments: And in Gibeon there dwelt the father of Gibeon, [Jeiel], whose wife's name was Maacah;

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:30
segments: and his first-born son Abdon, and Zur, and Kish, and Baal, and Nadab,

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:31
segments: and Gedor, and Ahio, and Zecher.

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:32
segments: And Mikloth begat Shimeah. And they also dwelt with their brethren in Jerusalem, over against their brethren.

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:33
segments: And Ner begat Kish; and Kish begat Saul; and Saul begat Jonathan, and Malchi-shua, and Abinadab, and Eshbaal.

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:34
segments: And the son of Jonathan was Merib-baal; and Merib-baal begat Micah.

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:35
segments: And the sons of Micah: Pithon, and Melech, and Tarea, and Ahaz.

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:36
segments: And Ahaz begat Jehoaddah; and Jehoaddah begat Alemeth, and Azmaveth, and Zimri; and Zimri begat Moza.

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:37
segments: And Moza begat Binea; Raphah was his son, Eleasah his son, Azel his son.

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:38
segments: And Azel had six sons, whose names are these: Azrikam, Bocheru, and Ishmael, and Sheariah, and Obadiah, and Hanan. All these were the sons of Azel.

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:39
segments: And the sons of Eshek his brother: Ulam his first-born, Jeush the second, and Eliphelet the third.

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:40
segments: And the sons of Ulam were mighty men of valor, archers, and had many sons, and sons' sons, a hundred and fifty. All these were of the sons of Benjamin.
